lesson.menu_desc: The officer at Miami airport and his questions -- What, Where and How long with the verb to be
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 3 -- Immigration
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Eliane Zippo Guerreiro | Lesson 3 -- Immigration
lesson.grammar_point: wh- questions with be (what, where, how long)
lesson.pre_a1_modelo: Vacation. My visit is one week.

listenings.text: Welcome to Miami International Airport. U.S. citizens, please go to line A. Visitors, please go to line B. Please have your passport and your form in your hand. The wait is about twenty minutes today. Thank you.

Hello. My name is Daniel Ruiz. I am an officer at Miami airport. My questions are always the same. What is your name? Where are you from? What is the purpose of your visit? How long is your visit? Short answers are okay. My job is not difficult, and the visitors are nice.

extra_audio.text: The officer says: Your passport, please. Eliane says: Here it is. The officer asks: What is the purpose of your visit? Eliane says: Vacation. The officer says: Welcome to the United States.
